name: obras
description: Field notebook PWA for construction jobs: address, entry code, tasks, photos and history in one place, even offline.

paragraphs: A field notebook for construction jobs: address, entry code, tasks, photos and history in one place, on the phone, even offline.
🌐 Open the app · About · Features · Run locally

On a construction crew, the information for each job lives in a WhatsApp thread: the address, the gate code, what still needs doing, a photo of the front of the house. Finding it again on site, with one hand and a weak signal, wastes time every day.
features: One card per job with a photo of the front, address, city and the entry code highlighted.
Real navigation. The route button opens Waze, Google Maps or Apple Maps.
Everything about the job: water and power on site, tasks, notes, photos and a history of updates.
In progress and done tabs, with search by street, city, code or service.
Works without signal in read-only mode, using what was saved on the device.

whatItDoes.text: A field notebook for construction jobs: address, entry code, tasks, photos and history in one place, on the phone, even offline.

requirements.text: Installable on the home screen (PWA), with email or Google sign-in.
Environment variables, deploy, Google sign-in setup and the database schema are documented in docs/MAINTENANCE.md (in Portuguese).
